summary: indexOf returns the zero-based position of the first matching substring at or after a starting position.
documentation: indexOf returns the zero-based position of the first matching substring at or after a starting position. It is case-sensitive and returns -1 when there is no match.
inputs: A search string and optional starting position.
caution: Index zero is a valid match but is falsey. Check against -1; string indices count UTF-16 code units.
scenarios: Find where a pasted reference separates its prefix and number.
Highlight the first literal search match in a short label.
Locate a delimiter before extracting two fields.
title: Locate the first separator
problem: Input is a string containing ASCII text. Return the index of its first colon, or -1 when absent. Return only the first position even if there are multiple colons.
goal: Use String.indexOf() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Search for the literal colon and preserve -1 when missing.
